name: ricos-epos-app
description: Sunmi T2 Android wrapper (Capacitor) for the Rico's / Food Station staff EPOS. One APK, provisioned per device to a shop. Self-contained — does not affect the web build.

scripts.assets: capacitor-assets generate --android || echo 'asset generation skipped (icons unchanged)'
scripts.prepare:android: npm run sync-web && cap add android && npm run patch-android && npm run assets
scripts.sync: npm run sync-web && cap sync android && npm run patch-android && npm run assets
scripts.ota:publish: npm run sync-web && npx @capgo/cli@latest bundle upload --channel production
